title: Founding of Trier
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: PROVISIONAL: no CFAH, Ussher–Jones or Ussher date exists, so the sort uses Generations (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), PDF p. 128): about 2053 BC. Pending owner decision (open question A8).
